connected.description: Calculate power-zone watt ranges from FTP watts (7-zone numbering)
connected.name: calculate_zones

connected.description: Fetch athlete profile from intervals.icu (FTP, weight, max HR, sport settings, zones)
connected.name: intervals_fetch_athlete

connected.description: Fetch wellness data from intervals.icu (fitness, fatigue, weight, HRV, resting HR, sleep). Form = fitness - fatigue.
connected.name: intervals_fetch_wellness

connected.description: Fetch one recorded activity by the `id` that `intervals_fetch_activities` listed, passed exactly as listed. Returns the activity's summary measurements plus `laps` when intervals.icu supplies them; `lapsSupplied: false` means it supplied none. Use only fields actually returned. Use this for Tier B+ workout reviews; for summary-only Tier A, use `intervals_fetch_activities`.
connected.name: intervals_fetch_activity

activityId.description: Activity `id` from intervals_fetch_activities. Pass exactly as listed.

connected.description: Fetch time-series channels for an activity by the `id` that `intervals_fetch_activities` listed, passed exactly as listed. Channel names are intervals.icu's own, including provider-specific channels such as smooth_grade. Returns only per-channel min/max/mean over the full series plus the sample count; no per-second data; do not use it for pacing, duration-based best efforts, quartile trends, decoupling, HR recovery, fade patterns, or indoor/outdoor comparisons. Use only minimum, maximum, and mean as descriptive recorded observations. They alone cannot establish session quality, recovery, or readiness, or justify changing the next session. Expensive to fetch (~10,800 samples per type for a 3-hour ride): call it only for Tier C deep reviews the athlete explicitly requests. For Tier A/B use `intervals_fetch_activities` and `intervals_fetch_activity`. Default types: watts, heartrate, cadence, time, altitude. A requested channel with nothing to summarize is named in `unanswered` and has no numbers.
connected.name: intervals_fetch_streams

activityId.description: Activity `id` from intervals_fetch_activities. Pass exactly as listed.

types.description: Channel names; defaults to watts, heartrate, cadence, time, altitude.

connected.description: Fetch recorded activity summaries for a date range. Each activity has an `id`, a local `start`, and the measurements intervals.icu recorded for it. Pass an `id` exactly as listed to `intervals_fetch_activity` or `intervals_fetch_streams`. Use only fields actually returned.
connected.name: intervals_fetch_activities

connected.description: List scheduled calendar workouts on intervals.icu for a date range. Use this BEFORE deleting so you can show the athlete the list (id, date, name) and ask which one to delete. Filters to WORKOUT category only. Each row carries a coachCreated flag; only coach-created workouts can be deleted with intervals_delete_workout. Pass coachCreatedOnly: true to return only coach-created events.
connected.name: intervals_list_events

coachCreatedOnly.description: Return only events created by this coach

connected.description: Call this only when the current message explicitly asks for it. Create a structured workout on the intervals.icu calendar. Past dates are refused — workouts can only be created for today or later.

connected.description: Write to long-term memory (replaces section content) or daily notes.
